h1: The 8 Best 3-Drawer Nightstands of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: the 8 best 3-drawer nightstands, with charging ports, LED lighting, and footprint compared for small bedrooms and dorms.
summary: The Huuger 3-drawer with USB-C is our best all-rounder, with 2 AC outlets and a USB-C port in a 15.7 inch wide frame. Yoobure is the pick for certified electronics, and SONGMICS BELLAH has the most ports. WLIVE offers the roomiest drawers and highest weight capacity, while the Huuger set of 2 suits matching bedside pairs.
intro: Many buyers choose a 3-drawer nightstand by looks and only later notice that the height does not match their mattress. A bedside table that sits 4 inches below your bed top means reaching down for your phone every night, and one that is much taller blocks a reading lamp.

We reviewed eight models on paper, comparing dimensions, materials, charging ports, and weight capacity. Charging features and LED lighting are bundled into most of these, so the ranking weighs build and footprint alongside the electronics.

products.name: Huuger 3-Drawer Rustic Brown Nightstand with USB-C
products.verdict: Slim 15.7 inch frame with USB-C and an open shelf.
products.description:
The Huuger measures 15.7 by 11.8 by 27.6 inches and uses P2 particleboard with a powder-coated steel frame. It has three fabric drawers plus an open shelf, and the electrical side is a pair of AC outlets plus one USB-A and one USB-C port. The top is stain resistant. It is priced at $25 to $50.

It leads the group because it combines a slim footprint with a USB-C port, which several cheaper rivals skip. Against the SONGMICS it gives up two charging ports but is shorter.

Buy it if you want a balanced bedside table for a small bedroom. The caveat is the particleboard build, which will not match solid wood durability.
pros: Open shelf for a lamp or book
products.idealFor: Small bedrooms needing a charging nightstand.
products.skipIf: You want solid wood or a deeper drawer.

products.name: Yoobure 3-Drawer White Nightstand with 16-Color LED, FCC & ETL Certified
products.verdict: FCC and ETL certified electrical components.
products.description:
Yoobure's nightstand measures 15.4 by 11.8 by 25.6 inches, built from wood board, a metal frame, and fabric drawers. The electrical components are FCC and ETL certified, with 2 AC outlets and 2 USB ports, and 16 RGB colors in 22 modes via app or remote. An X-bar support frame and adjustable feet help stability. It sits at $25 to $50.

Second place goes to the certification, which none of the other models list, though it has no USB-C port like the Huuger.

Choose it if electrical safety matters most. The caveat is the shorter 25.6 inch height.
products.skipIf: You want a taller table or USB-C.

products.name: SONGMICS BELLAH 3-Drawer White Nightstand with 5 Charging Ports
products.verdict: Five charging ports and a 66 lb capacity.
products.description:
The SONGMICS BELLAH stands 29.9 inches tall, the tallest here, at 15.6 by 11.8 inches. It mixes particleboard, steel, and PVC leather, with 3 drawers and an open shelf. Charging gives 2 AC, 2 USB-A, and 1 USB-C, five ports total. It also has app-controlled LED music sync, an anti-tip kit, and a 66 lb capacity, at $25 to $50.

It beats the Huuger on port count but costs you height, which suits raised beds only.

Best for a tall bed with several devices. The caveat is that the 29.9 inch height can look oversize on a low platform bed.
products.idealFor: Raised beds and heavy device users.
products.skipIf: You have a low platform bed.

products.name: Furnulem 3-Drawer Rustic Brown Nightstand with 3-Way Charging Install
products.verdict: The charging unit can be installed three ways.
products.description:
The Furnulem is 15.74 by 11.5 by 28.3 inches in particleboard with a metal frame and three fabric drawers. It offers 2 AC outlets and 2 USB ports, and the charging unit can be installed in three positions. An anti-toppling device is included. Price: $25 to $50.

It trails the Huuger because it lists no USB-C port and no open shelf, but flexible charging placement helps when your wall outlet is in an awkward spot.

Buy it if outlet position is tricky. The caveat is the lack of USB-C.

products.name: Lazzanto 3-Drawer Black Nightstand with Voice-Sync LED
products.verdict: The most advanced LED controls in the guide.
products.description:
The Lazzanto in black measures 15.6 by 11.4 by 29.4 inches, with a particleboard and metal frame, three fabric drawers, and a water-resistant top with rounded corners. It has 2 AC and 2 USB, plus LED voice, app, timer, and music sync, and a 50 lb capacity. Price is $50 to $100.

It costs more than the Huuger, with the extra money going to lighting rather than build.

Choose it if LED effects matter. The caveat is that you pay more for features you may not use.
products.skipIf: You just want charging and storage.

products.name: Lazzanto 3-Drawer White Nightstand with Voice-Sync LED
products.verdict: The same smart LED unit as the black version, in white.
products.description:
The white Lazzanto has the same 15.6 by 11.4 by 29.4 inch frame, three fabric drawers, water-resistant top, and 2 AC plus 2 USB with voice, app, timer, and music sync LEDs. The capacity is 50 lbs and it costs $50 to $100.

It ranks just under the black version only because it is a color variant, offering nothing new in features.

Pick it if white matches your room. The caveat is that it repeats the black model's specs.
products.idealFor: White bedroom schemes with smart lighting.
products.skipIf: You prefer black or do not want LEDs.

products.name: WLIVE Tall 3-Drawer Espresso Nightstand, 22.99" Wide
products.verdict: Roomiest drawers and a 110 lb capacity, but wide.
products.description:
The WLIVE measures 22.99 by 15.59 by 29.06 inches, the widest here, in engineered wood. It has 3 drawers with a 13.78 inch depth, the deepest, plus 2 AC and 2 USB, a waterproof top, smooth metal glides, and a 110 lb capacity, the highest. Price is $50 to $100.

It sits lower because the 22.99 inch width is hard to fit in a small bedroom.

Buy it if storage matters more than space. The caveat is the footprint.
products.idealFor: Bedrooms with space and lots to store.

products.name: Huuger Paint 3-Drawer White Nightstand Set of 2
products.verdict: A matching pair with the most premium finish listed.
products.description:
This is a set of two Huuger tables, each 23.62 by 15.75 by 23.62 inches, made of engineered wood, painted smooth, with reinforced side panels. Every table gets three deep drawers and the same outlet and port mix. It costs $200 to $500 for the pair.

It ranks last because of the price and wide, low shape, though per table the cost is less alarming.

Buy it for symmetrical bedsides. The caveat is the wide footprint.

whatMatters.detail: A nightstand should sit within a few inches of the mattress top so you reach items without bending. Heights here run from 23.62 to 29.9 inches. Measure your mattress top and compare it to the listed height.
Width and depth decide whether it fits beside the bed without blocking a walkway. Most picks are about 15.6 inches wide, while the WLIVE is nearly 23. Check width in the title or dimensions.
Ports include AC outlets, USB-A, and USB-C. USB-C matters for modern phones and tablets. Count ports in the bullets and check for USB-C.
A tall narrow table can tip, especially with kids or pets. Anti-tip kits and adjustable feet help. Look for 'anti-tip' or 'anti-toppling' on the listing.
Fabric drawers are light but can sag, while metal glides run smoothly on bigger drawers. Weight capacity ranges from 50 to 110 lbs. Check the stated capacity and drawer material.

cards.label: Look for
cards.text: A width near 15 inches with a charging unit, so it fits tight spaces and replaces a power strip.

cards.label: In this ranking
cards.text: The Huuger 3-Drawer with USB-C and the Yoobure are both about 15.5 inches wide.

cards.text: You need deep storage, where the WLIVE's 13.78 inch drawers and 110 lb capacity deliver, or you want smart LEDs from the Lazzanto.

cards.text: You want charging and three drawers, where the Huuger covers it for under $50.

faq.q: Will these fit in a dorm room?
faq.a: The 15 inch wide models should fit beside a standard twin bed. Check your wall outlet position first.

faq.q: What is the biggest mistake with nightstands?
faq.a: Ignoring bed height. A table well below the mattress top is awkward to use.

faq.q: Is the SONGMICS worth it over the Huuger?
faq.a: Only if you need five ports and a taller body. The Huuger is shorter and still has USB-C.
Follow the manual, install the anti-tip kit if provided, and plug the charging unit into a wall outlet. Use adjustable feet if your floor is uneven.

faq.q: How do I care for the top?
faq.a: Wipe with a damp cloth. Several tops are listed as stain or water resistant, but wipe spills quickly.

faq.q: Can I use it as a desk side table?
faq.a: Yes, but check height against your desk. Wide models like the WLIVE need more room.

finalTake: The Huuger with USB-C is the best bedside table for most small bedrooms, giving slim width, three drawers, and modern charging. Take the Yoobure for certified electronics or the SONGMICS if you need five ports. Measure your bed height and wall space before you decide.
